title: QUIC RFC 9000 S4P6 Cumulative Incoming Stream Limit Tail Verification
verification_method: Focused S4P6 requirement-home tests over cumulative incoming stream-count admission, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the generated non-clean S4P6 cumulative incoming-stream admission tail for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S4P6-0001.
expected_result: The focused tests show incoming stream frames at cumulative stream index one are admitted when the matching incoming stream-count limit is two, lower-numbered peer streams of the same type are created before admitting the target stream, and the existing over-limit negative proof continues to reject STREAM frames outside the advertised cumulative limit with STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR.
procedure: Run the focused S4P6 cumulative incoming-stream requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The S4P6 stream-limit local-open and inbound STREAM enforcement tail remains closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0076.
The base stream-state model remains owned by ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0001.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim max_streams oversized close-policy proof, metadata-only S4P6 xref cleanup, automatic stream-limit autotuning, public stream API widening, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Local verification on 2026-05-06 passed: focused S4P6-0001 requirement-home filter 3/3, combined S4P6 hard-tail filter 11/11, Release build 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated QUIC coverage triage at 1,304 of 1,771 trace-clean with S4P6-0001 trace-clean, SpecTrace core validation 481 artifacts, full Release no-build suite 4,564/4,564, and git diff --check.
